Private HTTP server state, connection, WebSocket, and staging buffer structures.

# Purpose
This header defines the private data structures and internal constants used by the HTTP server implementation. It declares state values for normal HTTP connections, WebSocket ping and frame handling, and optional Zstandard compression support through `zstd.h` when `FD_HAS_ZSTD` is enabled. The main `fd_http_server_private` structure stores server-wide state such as the socket file descriptor, staging buffers, connection limits, callback data, and pointers to arrays for HTTP connections, WebSocket connections, and `pollfd` entries. It also defines per-connection and per-WebSocket connection records, including treap links used for internal management of active connections.
